justification: Assessment returned INVALID and localized the flaw to lines 0062-0063, the |R_{m-1}| < n/2 branch where R_{m-1} is padded with arbitrary vertices of W_{m-1} and S is then claimed to have no neighbor in W_m 'since S contains R_{m-1}'. That is exactly the ground-truth flaw: monotonicity of N goes the wrong way, only R_{m-1} is known to avoid W_m, and the padding vertices of W_{m-1} \ R_{m-1} are unconstrained, so N(S) subset of V \ W_m and |N(S)| <= alpha n are unjustified and no contradiction follows. The assessment's witness is schematic (a padded vertex u in W_{m-1} with an edge u-w into W_m) rather than the ground truth's concrete n=6 graph, but it is a valid instantiation of the same defect and the ground-truth witness realizes it. Same claim, same defect, valid supporting witness.
